question: Re-read the Match Trigger semi-only effects on 2.1.1.0 (GRM_MatchTrigger_ERG_P15 operands, GBM_NoIncrease_ERG_P00, the L4038 gate flag, the WB/GS bindings on the Match Trigger weapons, the M433's new W15 import), state whether the site's semiAuto block equals the source, compute the M433 predictions, and write the capture brief.

control.description: GRM_MatchTrigger_ERG_P15 recoil exponent add operand raw-checks +3 and the recovery multiply operand 1.728 at the L17 receipt's offsets (1144, 924, 616, 396); the file's raw SHA-256 equals the 1.4.3.0 and 1.4.3.5 hash, so the offsets carry forward by raw hash.

sourceFacts.operands: GRM_MatchTrigger_ERG_P15 (sha256 d7785a0b638a8d238c906d772481639137b244181f26dacb46f45c0461e32fa1, identical to 1.4.3.0 and 1.4.3.5): add +3 on RecoilAmountMultiplierExponent in both branches (offsets 1144, 616), second multiply 1.7280000448 on RecoilDecreaseFactor in both branches (924, 396); header Field_9ca063e9 true (offset 84). GBM_NoIncrease_ERG_P00 (sha256 f72b06b468711162922b73a16fd824cc0954d9f6f494149f2f1a6072d5e2cdde): multiply 0 on IncreasePerShot in four branches (912, 644, 376, 108); header Field_9ca063e9 true (84).
sourceFacts.bindings: By GUID search of the 2.1.1.0 trees, plus typed decode: 28 Match Trigger attachment files; GS binds identifier 15cff9ff to the same GRM and GBM file GUIDs on all 28 GS files; 26 WB files keep the local selector -> effect -> target -> record chain (record mask Field_1c85cbb1 = 1, 26 of 26 raw-checked): 25 of the 26 site weapons (all but the M433) plus Devgru, which is not a site weapon. The M433 imports WPM_ERG_MatchTrigger_W15. M44 (RagingHunter) has no WB chain. The 24 weapons of L24 therefore stand as 23 local chains plus the M433 package route on 2.1.1.0; with Mk 24 and RSPR the site list is 26.

m433W15.finding: HK433_WB (2.1.1.0 main capture, sha256 3f33f2ca3613e4965490e2aa82f32453a94ee9ae41f8eec6e227ef87bf6bb73b) holds no local Class_897c99a7 selector object with GUID 3eaeac2e (U_WPM_ERG_MatchTrigger_W15), no local effect/target/record chain and no identifier 15cff9ff; byte counts of 3eaeac2e, 15cff9ff and the bipod/mounted sibling identifiers are 0 (the 1.4.3.5 file has 1 of each). Modifier array Field_0cd9f20f element 99 instead imports WPM_ERG_MatchTrigger_W15 (file GUID 36d9d2e2-d5e9-4075-9e9d-9f4c9d148cad, class GUID 699fad30-5e47-4c42-a333-3a4e1f8715ad). That package (482 bytes, sha256 8c6605fccec05b6f7351c1ba77bbc8171d2f00a9f5d42b7e174f00c064c8a61a) holds one Class_897c99a7 object: Field_819acc98 = [3eaeac2e-a854-4cd1-90db-216da7845135] (the selector GUID the 1.4.3.5 local object held), Field_9690d604 = [] (EMPTY effect list; the 1.4.3.5 local object listed one effect), Field_1c31def0 null.
m433W15.addsOrReplaces: Replaces: the selector object moved out of the WB into the package and the package's effect list is empty. It adds no operand: no GRM/GBM import, no number, no identifier.
m433W15.gsUnchangedInKind: GS_HK433 (sha256 61b8c5791b177e0b2becff5cdb00c8c9a6649515ff41a6fc1572ff7efadb7dda) still binds identifier 15cff9ff to GBM_NoIncrease_ERG_P00 (priority 3) and GRM_MatchTrigger_ERG_P15 (priority 29), as on 1.4.3.0.
m433W15.identifierAsset: 15cff9ff-aab0-4230-9a53-5a2bb1606587 is the object GUID of U_WPM_ERG_MatchTriggerActive (sha256 5c82550512614328b56ee47f31c78dcf5986165d713cae31ca1290e219b23d4c), a condition asset present only in the 15 and 22 October hotfix client captures (absent from the 13 October main capture and from 1.4.3.5); only Devgru_Ability references it, not HK433_WB.
m433W15.inference: The M433's semi-gate record (mask 1) is no longer serialized in its WB; its remaining route to the two effects is the GS binding. Whether the effects now act in all modes, in none, or through a condition supplied elsewhere (for example the new U_WPM_ERG_MatchTriggerActive asset) is not established. This is why the M433 may differ from the other weapons.
m433W15.otherChanges: HK433_WB also gained six other imports and added or renamed classes; not traced (out of scope).

limits: The site applies the block to every recoil state; the source gives two branches (zoomed, unzoomed) with the same values.
The site does not model the per-weapon GS priority values (GBM 1 to 9, GRM 6 to 36 across weapons); no stacking rule is established (L24).
On the M433 the 2.1.1.0 WB lost the local selector chain, so M433 activation is the least certain of the 26 (see m433W15).

sourceFacts.predictions: M433 ADS, 10 m, site model: per-shot amount 0.79333 -> 0.6695 deg (ratio 0.843908625), factor 72 -> 124.416 (site scale 0.8: 57.6 -> 99.5328). Hole 2 above hole 1: 200 ms 4.97 cm bare vs 1.92 cm Match Trigger; 150 ms 7.54 vs 4.45; 300 ms 0.97 vs 0.00. 5th hole above 1st at 200 ms: 8.87 vs 2.61 cm. Auto: no difference. Auto held-fire ADS bloom 0.05 -> 0.64 deg bare vs 0.05 flat if the block acts in auto. See l4073-result.json predictions and arithmetic.json.

inference: The site block equals the 2.1.1.0 operands; the semi gate (mask 1, header flag) remains an inference from L31 and L4038, and the capture is the activation test.

On the M433 the W15 package replaces the local selector object and carries an empty effect list, adding no operand; the M433's semi-gate record is no longer in its WB. Runtime consequence unknown; the M433 result may not transfer to the other weapons, so the brief adds a conditional AK4D control.
Cadence 300 ms is uninformative (0.97 vs 0.00 cm); the brief uses 200 ms.
unresolved: Runtime activation, fire-mode gating and composition of the Match Trigger effects remain unproven; the semi reading (mask 1, header flag) is inference (L31, L4038). Needs the L4073 capture.
What the empty-effect-list W15 package means for the M433 at runtime is not established; the six other added HK433_WB import file GUIDs were not resolved to assets.
Whether the hotfix-only condition asset U_WPM_ERG_MatchTriggerActive is the intended Match Trigger gate, and whether it reaches the M433, is not traced.
M44 (RagingHunter): the attachment exists with GS bindings but no WB chain; not on the site list.
Per-weapon GS priority values and any stacking rule are unknown (L24).
siteImpact: None to apply now: the site's semiAuto block equals the 2.1.1.0 source operands (data/attachments.json ERGOS match_trigger semiAuto; sim/applyAttachments.js applies it in semi only). assets.question: Are the L17 Match Trigger recoil exponent (+3) and recovery multiply (1.728) operands and the header gate flag unchanged on 2.1.1.0?
assets.conclusion: Byte-identical to 1.4.3.0/1.4.3.5; +3 at 1144 and 616, 1.728 at 924 and 396, header flag Field_9ca063e9 true at 84.

assets.question: Is the Match Trigger bloom multiply 0 and its header gate flag unchanged on 2.1.1.0?
assets.conclusion: Byte-identical to earlier builds; multiply 0.0 at 912, 644, 376, 108; header flag true at 84.

assets.question: What does the package the M433 newly imports hold, and does it add or replace the P15 effects?
assets.conclusion: One selector object with GUID 3eaeac2e and an empty effect list; no operands. It replaces the local WB selector object; adds nothing.

assets.question: Which Match Trigger chain does the 2.1.1.0 M433 weapon body hold?
